setup.zh: 告示上写：离堆堰坼，夜有巨牛斗江，声闻十里；田庐尽没。有能安之者，蜀守重赏。城里的坊市照常开着：蜀锦一匹一匹挂在竹竿上，银匠铺里叮叮当当地敲着银。
setup.en: The notice says: the weir at Lidui is cracking; at night a great ox fights the river, heard ten li off; fields and houses are under water. Whoever can settle it, the governor of Shu will reward. Inside the city the market is open as ever: bolts of Shu brocade hang from bamboo poles, and in the silversmiths' shops the silver rings under the hammer.

recap.zh: 成都的告示说，离堆的堰在裂，夜里有巨牛斗江，田庐尽没。
recap.en: Chengdu's notice said the weir at Lidui was cracking and a great ox fought the river at night; fields and houses were drowned.

text.zh: 李冰斗过江神——两个都化成了牛。……这头牛等的是他。
text.en: Li Bing fought the river god — both of them turned into oxen. …This ox is waiting for him.

alone.zh: 李冰斗江神，二者都化成了牛。这头牛在等他。
alone.en: When Li Bing fought the river god, both became oxen. This ox is waiting for him.

text.zh: 离堆在城西北，顺着岷江往上走。
text.en: Lidui lies north-west of the city, up the Min.

exits.means: goes to Lidui, to the weir and the ox

text.zh: 你顺江往西北走。夜里，前面传来一声闷响，像一头牛把角撞在了山上。
text.en: North-west up the river. At night a dull boom sounds ahead, like an ox driving its horns into a mountain.

exits.means: goes shopping, asks about the market, wants to buy or sell

text.zh: 银匠说，梁州的银最白，打出来的铃，声音也最清。
text.en: A silversmith says Liang's silver is the whitest, and a bell made of it rings the clearest.
…So the bell's silver came from here.

alone.zh: 你带着的那只银铃，轻轻响了一声。
alone.en: The silver bell you carry gives a faint ring.

exits.means: asks the townspeople about the ox and Li Bing

text.zh: 老人说：李太守当年跟江神斗，斗不过，上岸喊了一声：向南腰中正白者，我绶也。他的主簿一剑刺了北边那头。
text.en: An old man says: when Governor Li fought the river god and was losing, he climbed out and called: the one facing south with white at its waist — that is my sash. His clerk drove a sword into the one facing north.
